checks.detail: Recomputed byte counts and SHA-256 for all 16 frozen snapshots immediately before receipt creation; all match the packet. Plan observation hashes match their frozen text snapshots.

Frozen native text and pixels show source21:25 as State OPEN / Stream HIGH, source21:55 as State OPEN / Stream MEDIUM, both272x896;14:18 is PRIM-015 / General action button / base,220x56, with Label Book a conversation. The HIGH appearance has pending Balanced; MEDIUM has pending Simplified. Therefore the trial must explicitly author each declared pending default on owned copies; source variants alone do not implement the trial. Selected-source observations do not certify all parent/descendant/font/token/reaction bindings.

All eight unique Active/Pending/Directory combinations for HIGH/MEDIUM are present and reachable from H_OPEN_M. All 18 edges resolve existing symbols. Close/Escape/reopen preserve route Services, query design and active/pending pair; selection edges change pending only; Apply changes active to pending and retains the open panel/context; two current-choice edges are self no-ops. These are structural/semantic plan checks, not Presentation tests.

One isolated owned root contains the set, preview frame/instance and synthetic children; no existing source mutation, deletion, new file, sharing/account/plugin/paid action, MCP/AI call or Git operation is requested. Source admission, discovered copy IDs and selected-control/target ownership checks precede each affected mutation. Failed qualification is preserved and held, with no automatic correction/retry or alternative topology. Whole-page census is not assumed.

Internal modal-reference content changes with the same owning host variant, avoiding a separately swapped overlay that could leave the underlying host stale. Only the private fixture controls in the active layer may be wired. This is a visual/interaction simulation, not real modality, DOM inertness, native form/radio behavior, keyboard focus or AT proof. Services/design labels carry no visitor data, credentials, proof/tickets or backend state. No functional PRIM coverage, four-stream/full-profile coverage, timing-extension result or full B01 acceptance is claimed.

Before/after native exports, hashes/CRC, raw Presentation captures and actual ID/settings records are required. The root remains labelled qualification-only; neither cleanup/deletion nor tested restore/_EXIT is implied.

findings.title: Exercise both no-op paths, every close/reopen context and inactive background behavior
findings.finding: The explicit M_OPEN_M current-choice Apply edge is never clicked by NQ-01 through NQ-06; NQ-04 exercises only H_OPEN_H no-op. The click Close and Open directory edges for M_OPEN_H and H_OPEN_H are not exercised by the written sequences, because NQ-06 uses Escape only. This matters because the two source variants have different inherited pending defaults, and each owned closed/open pair can have independently mistaken controls or targets. NQ-06 also asserts that inactive underlying controls do not activate without explicitly attempting a background control activation or recording its verified absence of inherited reactions. A statement of expected inactivity is not an observed negative test.
findings.repair: Retain the same eight variants, 18 edges and six observation IDs. Extend NQ-02 to click current-choice Apply in M_OPEN_M and observe unchanged active/pending/panel/query/route/scroll with no inherited action. Extend NQ-06 to enter each of the four open contexts through listed edges, attempt an identifiable underlying fixture control while open, then exercise click Close -> matching closed -> Open directory -> original open and Escape -> matching closed -> Open directory -> original open. Record actual owned target IDs, unchanged or restored active/pending/route/query labels and the scroll anchor where preservation is required. Map the observations to the actual edge records and capture native reaction absence/overrides for the negative controls. Stop on any mismatch; no additional topology, corrective loop, paid feature or external action is released by this repair.

Before a source copy, perform the planned fresh native source admission. The frozen snapshots establish expected selected-source traits only. Missing required ownership/descendant/property/font/token/reaction data stops the affected operation; do not infer it from the images or waive it.

After exact applicable founder trial-write permission, create only the isolated owned root, discover real new IDs, and bind new controls to the recorded owning parent variants. An inherited source-instance alias or edit-main-component path is not an owned target.

During this bounded trial record the actually available native Change to parent target, Instant/stable transition, component-state carryover/reset behavior, and preview/nested vertical-overflow configuration. Define and record an identifiable scroll anchor and compare actual nonzero offset before/after both Apply directions and relevant close/reopen/selection paths. Similar dimensions/names do not prove preservation. A missing setting or failed observation stops without alternative topology or retry.

Leave diagonal Apply controls with verified no action or equivalent no-transition behavior; do not invent a native action called No transition. Keep underlying controls free of inherited interactions while the internal modal-reference layer is open. Escape is a key simulation and focus-return is an annotation, not actual native modality.

Record result captures, actual source/copy/control/target/setting bindings and native before/after exports; obtain a separate result review. A positive result supports only this two-stream mechanism qualification and cannot release the complete B01 executable plan, functional primitives, production design, runtime/AT conformance or pilot acceptance.
